title: Interior slab
request: My office door rubs. Can you replace it with a slab like the others?
contractor_reply: The frame is square. Owner bought a blank slab of the measured size; reuse hinges and knob, fit and paint both faces white. $390 fixed.
expected: Blank slab fitted and painted; hardware retained; no frame.
first_response: Where does the old slab rub, and is the jamb square with firm hinges? Check the proposed slab against the opening, hinge mortises and latch bore. Which hardware stays and who finishes the slab and cut edges?
contractor_review: The square frame and measured blank settle the fit. Confirm the finish for any exposed trimmed edges alongside the white faces.
homeowner_estimate:
Office door replacement
I’ll fit your blank slab to the existing frame, cut the hinge mortises and knob and latch openings, and transfer your hinges and knob. I’ll paint both faces white and check that the door swings freely and latches.
Fixed price — $390.
observation: Two faces and the $390 are correct. The review raises cut-edge finishing; the customer has no indication whether it is included if an edge is exposed.

title: Exterior entry
request: Cold air comes in under our front door. We already ordered the replacement.
contractor_reply: It is a prehung unit; verified dimensions, sill sound, same opening. $950 labor, includes flashing and refitting inside and outside trim. Owner supplies unit and paints.
expected: Prehung rather than slab; preserve labor-only and paint responsibility.
first_response: What exactly did they order, a sweep, slab or prehung unit? Compare the actual unit to the opening, jamb depth, sill and trim footprint. What interior casing, storm door or hardware should go back?
contractor_review: The ordered prehung unit fits the existing opening, and the sill is sound. The figure is labor only. Confirm who supplies flashing and trim consumables.
homeowner_estimate:
Front entry door installation
I’ll remove the existing door unit and install your prehung replacement in the same opening, flash it, refit the inside and outside trim, and check swing and latch. You’ll supply the door unit and handle painting.
Installation labor — $950.
observation: The review asks who supplies flashing and trim consumables. The copy promises the installation at a labor-only price but does not say these material responsibilities are open or mark the draft pending.

title: Stained drywall
request: Our upstairs leak left a brown patch on the dining room ceiling. Can you make it disappear?
contractor_reply: Plumber repaired leak, ceiling now dry and firm. Spot-prime then paint the full 12 by 14 ceiling, no drywall replacement. $520 fixed.
expected: Do not quote leak repair or new drywall; whole-ceiling paint.
first_response: Who repaired the leak, and have you confirmed the ceiling is dry and firm? What texture and paint finish do they expect, and are they asking for a spot repair or the whole ceiling painted to its edges?
contractor_review: The plumber has repaired the leak and the ceiling is dry and firm. The paint boundary is the entire dining room ceiling.
homeowner_estimate:
Dining room ceiling stain repair
I’ll spot-prime the dry stain and paint the full 12-by-14-foot dining room ceiling. The existing drywall stays in place.
Fixed price — $520.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Drywall finish
request: Could you patch the holes the electrician left? Our wall has a texture.
contractor_reply: Four openings; match orange peel and prime patches only. Owner paints whole wall. No price yet.
expected: Four patches with texture and primer only; exact unpriced label.
first_response: How many openings, how large, and has the electrician released them for closing? Can you agree on a texture sample and where the paint stops before quoting the finish?
contractor_review: Confirm the electrician has released the four openings before closing them. Your handoff is primed patches, with the owner painting the wall.
homeowner_estimate:
Textured wall repair
Scope draft — pricing to follow.
Once the electrical work is ready to cover, I’ll close the four openings, match the surrounding orange-peel texture, and prime the patched areas. You’ll paint the full wall.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: One damaged plank
request: The middle plank in my click-floor is gouged. Can you just swap it?
contractor_reply: Matching spare verified. Product unclicks from nearest wall; shift dresser, lift and relay four rows, reinstall baseboard. $340 complete.
expected: Include access and reinstatement; no entire floor or material allowance.
first_response: Do they have a matching plank with the same locking profile? From which wall can you release the rows, and can you reach the gouge without moving a built-in? That determines the trim and relaying work.
contractor_review: The spare matches and the product releases from the nearest wall. Four rows and the dresser move are covered by the complete price.
homeowner_estimate:
Gouged floor plank replacement
I’ll shift the dresser, remove the baseboard for access, and lift four rows from the nearest wall. I’ll replace the gouged plank with the matching spare, relay the rows, reinstall the baseboard, and return the dresser.
Complete repair — $340.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Carpet transition
request: Please replace our bedroom carpet with vinyl. I want the door to still swing.
contractor_reply: Measured 120 sq ft. Install owner-supplied LVP on inspected ready floor, remove carpet, haul it and add reducer at hall; swing checked. $720 labor package.
expected: 120 sq ft, reducer, haul, no invented floor supply.
first_response: What area does the vinyl cover, and who handles carpet, pad, disposal and baseboards? Compare the selected floor build-up against door swing and the adjoining floor. Will the threshold fit or will it need changing?
contractor_review: The 120 square feet are measured. The substrate and door swing have been checked. The labor package includes tear-out, haul-away and reducer installation.
homeowner_estimate:
Bedroom vinyl plank floor
I’ll remove and haul away the carpet, install 120 square feet of your vinyl plank on the prepared floor, fit a reducer at the hall, and check that the bedroom door swings freely.
Labor package — $720.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Rocking toilet
request: The toilet rocks. Do we need to buy a new one?
contractor_reply: Porcelain intact. $210 to pull and reset existing toilet with new seal if flange is sound. If flange broken, photograph and quote before separate owner approval. No replacement ordered.
expected: Existing toilet reset; observable flange trigger, approval; no new fixture.
first_response: Is the bowl intact, and what moves when you check it against the floor? Is the floor firm, and can you inspect the flange or only see it after lifting? Would they keep the existing toilet if you can reset it securely?
contractor_review: The intact toilet can be reused. Flange condition is the decision point after lifting it, and the owner has authorized no flange repair.
homeowner_estimate:
Rocking toilet reset
I’ll lift your existing toilet and inspect the flange. If it’s sound, I’ll reset the toilet with a new seal and check for movement and leaks. Pull and reset with a sound flange — $210.
If the flange is broken, I’ll pause the reset, show you a photo and give you a separate repair quote. I’ll wait for your approval before doing that work.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Vanity shutoffs
request: Could you put this wider vanity where the little one is?
contractor_reply: New vanity does not clear current shutoffs. Owner hires plumber to move them first. $450 for install after sign-off, reconnect sink only; owner patches wall.
expected: Plumber and wall work separate; $450 limited.
first_response: Can you check the actual vanity with the drawers open against existing piping, door trim and outlets? Who supplies the top and faucet, and what connection or finish work do they expect when you leave?
contractor_review: The shutoffs conflict with the wider cabinet. The owner arranges the plumber’s relocation and sign-off before your installation, and handles wall patching.
homeowner_estimate:
Wider vanity installation
You’ll arrange for your plumber to move the shutoffs clear of the new vanity. After the plumber signs off, I’ll install the vanity, reconnect the sink, and check the sink connections for leaks. You’ll patch the wall.
Vanity installation and sink reconnection — $450.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Bathroom caulk
request: The white seam along my tub is peeling. Can you redo that this week?
contractor_reply: Dry joint, solid tile. Remove and replace caulk only at tub-to-tile seam. $145. Tell owner to wait for product's cure time.
expected: Local seam, no retile, no invented cure hours.
first_response: Is only the caulk coming loose, or does the tub or surround move at that seam? Check for signs of moisture before promising a reseal. Which edges are included, and can the tub be kept dry through the product’s cure?
contractor_review: The joint is dry and the tile is solid. Confirm the selected caulk’s cure time when giving the owner a return-to-use time.
homeowner_estimate:
Tub-to-tile seam reseal
I’ll remove the peeling caulk, prepare the dry joint and apply new caulk along the tub-to-tile seam. I’ll let you know when the product’s cure time is up. Please keep the seam dry until then.
Seam repair — $145.
observation: Cure-time advice is appropriate. 'I’ll let you know when ... cure time is up' can imply an unagreed later follow-up rather than instructions at handoff.

title: TV over fireplace
request: We bought a TV and want it up over the mantel with no dangling wires.
contractor_reply: Backing verified, bracket supplied. $220 mount and surface raceway only. They accepted visible paintable cover; no new outlet or in-wall routing.
expected: Surface raceway not hidden wiring, no paint promise.
first_response: Have you located suitable backing for their TV and bracket at the chosen height and checked the fireplace clearances? Would they accept a surface cord cover, or are they expecting a new receptacle behind the TV? That changes the hookup scope.
contractor_review: Backing and the supplied bracket are confirmed. The owner accepts the visible paintable cover. Confirm mantel clearance for the chosen spot before mounting.
homeowner_estimate:
TV mounting over mantel
I’ll mount the TV on the supplied bracket at the verified backing and run the cords in a visible, paintable surface cover. The existing outlet stays in use.
TV mounting and surface raceway — $220.
observation: Backing is verified; fireplace clearance is not. The review says to confirm clearance, but the homeowner is promised the chosen position unconditionally.

title: Floating shelves
request: Can you hang three heavy floating shelves on my plaster wall?
contractor_reply: Backing not verified. $75 site check only, no installation authorized; report options after check.
expected: Inspection only; no installation promise or price.
first_response: What will the shelves carry, and where do the bracket holes land relative to solid backing behind the plaster? If a bracket misses, will the owner shift the shelves or do they want backing added and plaster repaired?
contractor_review: Backing is unverified. The only authorized work is the site check. Decide on locations and installation after the findings.
homeowner_estimate:
Floating shelf mounting assessment
I’ll inspect the proposed locations for the three heavy shelves, check for suitable support behind the plaster and report the mounting options. You can decide on installation after reviewing the findings.
Site check only — $75.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Cabinet door
request: One kitchen cabinet door hangs crooked. Can you make it shut again?
contractor_reply: Cup hole intact; replace two worn matching hinges and align that one door. $105 all in. Other doors fine.
expected: Two hinges one door; no refinishing or broad caveats.
first_response: With the door open, does the hinge or mounting plate shift, are its screw holes stripped, or does the door bind against the cabinet? Are the existing hinge and door sound enough to adjust or repair?
contractor_review: The hinge cup is sound. Two matching hinges and alignment on the affected door comprise the whole repair.
homeowner_estimate:
Kitchen cabinet door repair
I’ll replace the two worn hinges with matching hinges, align the affected door, and check that it opens and closes cleanly.
Complete repair — $105.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Drawer slides
request: The big pantry drawer sticks halfway. Is it worth replacing the whole thing?
contractor_reply: Box square. Replace pair of side-mount slides at matching length and load rating. $135 fixed; keep drawer and front.
expected: Pair not two priced sets; keep drawer.
first_response: Empty the drawer and run it again. Is the box square, are both slides straight and fastened, and does it bind at the same point? If a slide is damaged, can you match its length, mounting and load rating?
contractor_review: The square drawer box and front can stay. Confirm the replacement pair matches the existing slide length and load rating.
homeowner_estimate:
Pantry drawer repair
I’ll retain the drawer and its front, replace the pair of side-mount slides with matching-length slides of the same load rating, and check full drawer travel.
Fixed price — $135.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Window screen
request: Can you fix the ripped screen the cat got through?
contractor_reply: One frame is straight; rescreen with owner-selected pet mesh and reuse frame. $95 including mesh.
expected: Rescreen only, no replacement frame or pet guarantee.
first_response: Is the tear confined to the mesh, and does the frame still sit square and fit its opening? Do they want standard mesh or a pet-resistant replacement compatible with that frame?
contractor_review: The straight frame can be reused. The owner selected pet mesh and its cost is included.
homeowner_estimate:
Screen repair
I’ll remove the torn mesh from one screen, fit your selected pet mesh in the existing frame, and check the fit in the opening.
Repair including mesh — $95.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Fogged window
request: Our double-pane window stays cloudy after cleaning. Can you reseal it?
contractor_reply: I can measure the insulated glass unit for a glazier, not replace glass. $80 for measurement visit only.
expected: No confirmed seal diagnosis, no glass installation or referral fee.
first_response: Is the fog on a reachable surface or trapped between the panes? Does the sash operate and is the frame sound? That determines whether to address the surrounding seal or arrange a matching insulated glass unit.
contractor_review: Your scope ends at measuring the insulated glass unit for the glazier. The measurement visit carries the entire stated price.
homeowner_estimate:
Cloudy window glass measurement
I’ll measure the insulated glass unit and provide the dimensions for a glazier to assess replacement. This visit covers measurement only.
Measurement visit — $80.
observation: The final $80 measurement-only visit is sound. The first turn implies locating the fog is enough to decide whether an exterior seal needs attention; surface condensation alone does not establish that.

title: Sticky lock
request: Please fix our front lock; my key works with the door open.
contractor_reply: Latch binds only when closed. Hinges and door are firm. Adjust strike and test with existing key. $90. No new lock.
expected: Strike adjustment only; no rekey.
first_response: When you close the door, does lifting or pressing it let the key turn? Check hinge play and where the bolt meets the strike before quoting lock parts. Do they need the same key afterward?
contractor_review: Firm hinges and a firm door point to the strike adjustment. The existing lock and key stay.
homeowner_estimate:
Front door strike adjustment
I’ll adjust the strike so the latch engages with the door closed, then check that the door latches and the lock operates with your existing key.
Repair — $90.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Rotten trim
request: A corner of the trim by our garage feels soft. Can you patch the bad bit?
contractor_reply: Price $320 covers one 5-ft exterior trim board, prime and paint. Behind it can't be seen; if sheathing soft, show it and get approval of a separate quote before continuing.
expected: Localized board; sheathing not included/automatic.
first_response: Where does the trim become firm on both sides, and can you match its profile? Check where water reaches the corner and what can only be inspected after removal. Does your work include correcting that source and finishing the replacement?
contractor_review: One five-foot board, priming and painting are covered. The sheathing is concealed until removal. Confirm finish color before the visit.
homeowner_estimate:
Garage exterior trim repair
I’ll replace one 5-foot exterior trim board, then prime and paint the replacement. Trim repair — $320.
If removal exposes soft sheathing, I’ll stop before covering it, show you the affected area and give you a separate repair quote. I’ll wait for your approval before continuing.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Grab bar
request: Can you put a grab bar in the shower where my mom reaches?
contractor_reply: Owner marked position; backing not confirmed. I will inspect first. No price and no permission to open tile or install until support confirmed.
expected: Verification only; no promise based on visible tile, no quote.
first_response: Can her mom mark where she reaches while entering and using the shower? Verify what backs both mounting points through the actual wall finish. If they miss suitable backing, would a nearby position work or will the wall need opening and restoration?
contractor_review: Use the marked position for a non-destructive inspection. If backing can’t be verified, discuss next steps before disturbing the tile.
homeowner_estimate:
Shower grab bar location check
Scope draft — pricing to follow.
I’ll inspect the marked location for support at the mounting points and share what I can verify. If support remains uncertain, we’ll discuss options. This visit is inspection only. Opening the tile or installing the bar requires a separate agreement.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Mirror removal
request: I'd like that giant bathroom mirror removed and saved for my sister.
contractor_reply: Mirror glued; owner changed mind, accepts disposal, not salvage. $225 includes protection, removal, haul; patch and paint separately by owner.
expected: Correction eliminates salvage promise; no paint.
first_response: Can you tell whether clips, adhesive or both hold it, and how large is the mirror? Check access to release it and the route to a padded handoff. If intact removal is uncertain, what does the owner want you to do before attempting it?
contractor_review: The owner has changed the requested outcome to disposal. The glued mirror need not be saved. Patching and painting belong to the owner.
homeowner_estimate:
Bathroom mirror removal
I’ll protect the surrounding area, remove the glued mirror, and haul it away for disposal. You’ll handle wall patching and painting after removal.
Protection, removal and haul-away — $225.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Flat pack
request: Could you assemble the bunk bed before our guests arrive?
contractor_reply: One supplied kit, all parts checked, room ready. $190 assembly including manufacturer-specified anchoring; cardboard flattened in owner's garage.
expected: Do not promise haul; include specified anchoring.
first_response: Which model is it, are the instructions and complete hardware on site, and what is the deadline? Check the final room position, upper-bunk clearance, mattress thickness and access for the ladder before committing to assembly.
contractor_review: Parts and room are ready. Confirm the assembly date against the guests’ arrival and the manufacturer’s clearance requirements at the chosen position.
homeowner_estimate:
Bunk bed assembly
I’ll assemble one supplied bunk bed kit in the prepared room, install the manufacturer-specified anchoring, and flatten the cardboard in your garage.
Assembly and anchoring — $190.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Bi-fold doors
request: My closet doors jump out of their track. Can you make them work?
contractor_reply: Two panels reusable, worn top guide and pivot. $120 covers replacing both parts, adjustment and testing. No new doors.
expected: Repair hardware, test movement, no replacement.
first_response: Are these bypass or bifold doors, and what moves when one jumps? Check rollers or pivots, track alignment and the floor guide before deciding whether adjustment or parts will get both doors running.
contractor_review: Both panels are reusable. The two identified parts, adjustment and testing are covered.
homeowner_estimate:
Closet door repair
I’ll replace the worn top guide and pivot, adjust the two existing door panels, and test that they travel and close without jumping the track.
Complete repair — $120.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Blinds
request: We have six sets of inside-mount blinds. Can you install them all?
contractor_reply: Five fit. Owner will exchange sixth; $175 fixed to install five now. Return trip unpriced and unscheduled.
expected: Only five installed now, preserve future pricing uncertainty without erasing $175.
first_response: Has each blind been matched to its own opening for width, depth and bracket clearance? Are the mounts compatible with the frame, and if one blind is mis-sized, who handles its exchange and the return visit?
contractor_review: Five blinds fit now. The sixth is the owner’s exchange. No price or date has been agreed for a return visit.
homeowner_estimate:
Inside-mount blind installation
I’ll install the five blinds that fit their openings and check their operation. You’ll exchange the sixth blind. We can agree on a price and date for that installation once the replacement fits.
Fixed price for five blinds this visit — $175.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Ceiling patch beside light
request: Can you smooth the ceiling around the new light? The electrician left it rough.
contractor_reply: Electrician will remove and refit fixture. $185 patch, sand and prime the surrounding ring only. Owner paints.
expected: Fixture responsibility separate; no broad paint.
first_response: How far does the rough area extend, and has the electrician finished and cleared the opening for patching? Will the canopy cover the repair edge, and do they want a smooth patch, texture match or paint to a defined boundary?
contractor_review: The electrician handles removal and refitting. Coordinate that handoff with the owner’s painting; the price covers the ring only.
homeowner_estimate:
Ceiling repair around light fixture
After your electrician removes the fixture, I’ll patch, sand and prime the rough ring around the opening. You’ll paint the repair, and your electrician will refit the fixture.
Patch, sand and prime — $185.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Baseboard
request: Can you finish the baseboard after our new flooring went in?
contractor_reply: Measured 38 linear ft. Supply, cut, fit and caulk paint-grade base at $9 per installed ft; owner paints. No removal needed.
expected: 38 × 9 = 342; no removal, paint or waste markup.
first_response: Are you reinstalling salvaged base or supplying new pieces? What lengths, profile, corners and finish are needed, and does the base cover the flooring gap without interfering with doors?
contractor_review: At 38 measured linear feet the extension is $342. Confirm installed length with the owner and get approval for any increase before fitting more.
homeowner_estimate:
Paint-grade baseboard installation
I’ll supply, cut, fit and caulk paint-grade baseboard along the measured 38 linear feet. You’ll paint it. The area is ready for installation.
$9 per installed linear foot × 38 linear feet = $342. We’ll verify the length along the installed runs. If you request more, I’ll measure the additional run with you and get your approval on its price before installing it.
observation: The rate, measured quantity and $342 extension are right. A hypothetical future request for additional footage adds a change clause on a fully measured, simple job.

title: Kitchen pull list
request: Can you fix a cabinet pull, the sticking pantry latch and a loose towel ring in one visit?
contractor_reply: All three accessible, reuse hardware, blocking confirmed. $165 fixed for the whole visit. No disposal or spare parts needed.
expected: One bundled $165; no speculative extras or line prices.
first_response: For the pull, are the threads and cabinet holes sound? For the latch, where does it bind when the pantry closes? For the ring, is the bracket loose or has the wall anchor pulled out? Which parts are on hand so all three can be completed in one visit?
contractor_review: All three fixtures are accessible and the towel ring has backing. This is one fixed visit using existing hardware.
homeowner_estimate:
Three household hardware repairs
In one visit I’ll secure the cabinet pull, adjust the pantry latch so it closes freely, and secure the towel ring to its backing. I’ll reuse the existing hardware and check each repair.
Fixed price for all three repairs — $165.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Dishwasher exchange
request: The old dishwasher died. Can you install the new one and take the old one?
contractor_reply: Measured opening and connections work. $260 includes installation, securing, cycle/leak test and haul-away. Owner supplies dishwasher.
expected: $260 includes haul and testing; no separate fees.
first_response: With the old dishwasher’s feet lowered, can it clear the finished floor, and does the replacement fit the opening and mounting points? Are the existing connections ready for you to hook it up and run a fill, drain and leak check before hauling the old one away?
contractor_review: The measured opening and connections work. The owner supplies the dishwasher, and your fixed price includes haul-away.
homeowner_estimate:
Dishwasher replacement — $260

I’ll remove and haul away the old dishwasher, install and secure the dishwasher you supply, and connect it to the existing services. I’ll run a cycle and check for leaks.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: First dishwasher
request: We never had a dishwasher, but could you put one in the cabinet by the sink?
contractor_reply: Carpentry only. $480 to modify cabinet opening to chosen model dimensions. Owner arranges electrician, plumber and appliance installer.
expected: No connections or appliance install in cabinet price.
first_response: Which cabinet would come out, and does the selected dishwasher fit the finished opening? Where can it get water, power and a drain? Who will prepare those connections and finish the exposed cabinet edge before you set the machine?
contractor_review: The $480 ends at the prepared opening. Confirm the selected model number and which exposed cabinet edges need finishing before cutting.
homeowner_estimate:
Dishwasher cabinet opening — $480

I’ll modify the cabinet beside your sink to the dimensions required for your chosen dishwasher. You’ll arrange the electrician, plumber and appliance installer for the service connections and installation.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Counter-depth fridge
request: Can you get our new refrigerator through these narrow doors and hook it up?
contractor_reply: Appliance delivery crew handles carry-in. Existing water line passes fit and shutoff test; I level and connect, check for leaks. $125. No old appliance onsite.
expected: No delivery/removal quote or new water line.
first_response: Have you measured the tightest doorway and turn against the fridge dimensions with any removable handles or doors off? Will passage require removing a house door? Once it’s in place, does hookup include a water or ice connection, and is there a working shutoff there?
contractor_review: The delivery crew owns the narrow-door carry. Your $125 starts once the refrigerator is inside. The existing line and shutoff have been checked.
homeowner_estimate:
Refrigerator setup and water connection — $125

Your delivery crew will bring the refrigerator into the kitchen. I’ll level it, connect the verified existing water line and check the connection for leaks.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Gas range
request: I ordered a gas range to replace an electric one. Can you connect it?
contractor_reply: No gas at range; no conversion work from me. Owner gets qualified gas contractor and electrician. Do not quote an installation; no charge agreed.
expected: No false connection or price; meaningful next step.
first_response: Has anyone verified the gas supply, shutoff and electrical connection for this range at its final position? Who is providing and testing those services, and which part are you taking on, from moving the old range to securing and testing the new one?
contractor_review: There is no gas supply at the range, and you’ve offered no conversion or installation work. Give the owner a handoff note without a quote.
homeowner_estimate:
Gas range conversion inquiry

There’s no gas service at the range location. You’ll arrange a qualified gas contractor and an electrician to address the services needed for your selected range. No installation or charge has been agreed with me.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Induction cutout
request: Will you fit the induction cooktop where our old one sits?
contractor_reply: Selected model needs a larger stone cutout. Counter fabricator enlarges first, electrician handles electrical connection. $160 for setting and fastening only after both confirm fit/service.
expected: No stone or electrical work in $160.
first_response: Have you compared the new cooktop’s cutout template and depth with the existing opening and the drawers or oven underneath? What’s the countertop material, and who handles any opening change and verifies the electrical supply before you set the unit?
contractor_review: The larger stone opening is known work for the fabricator. Your $160 covers setting and fastening only, after the fabricator and electrician confirm readiness.
homeowner_estimate:
Induction cooktop placement — $160

The countertop fabricator will enlarge the stone opening for the selected cooktop. Once the fabricator confirms fit and the electrician confirms the electrical service is ready, I’ll set and fasten the cooktop. The electrician will make the electrical connection.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Over-range microwave
request: Can you hang the new microwave? We'd like it to vent outside.
contractor_reply: Existing unit recirculates. Owner chose same recirculation for now; verified cabinet, bracket backing and outlet. $240 includes swap, configure recirculation, testing and haul.
expected: Correction overrides initial outside vent request.
first_response: Is there an existing outdoor duct that actually lines up with this microwave’s outlet, or does someone need to create that route? Does the mounting template work with the wall backing and cabinet, with room for the door to open? Which mounting, duct and finish work are yours?
contractor_review: The owner chose recirculation, and you verified the cabinet, backing and outlet. The outdoor exhaust request is resolved.
homeowner_estimate:
Over-the-range microwave replacement — $240

I’ll remove the existing microwave, install the replacement, configure it for recirculation, test its operation and haul away the old unit.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Range hood
request: We have a hood in a box and want someone to install it for $200.
contractor_reply: Owner's $200 is their budget, not my quote. No duct route confirmed. My visit is to inspect fit and options only; visit fee not set.
expected: Budget not quoted price; inspection with pricing-to-follow.
first_response: Is $200 what the owner hopes to spend, or a price you’ve agreed to for specific work? Which hood is in the box and is it going to recirculate or exhaust outdoors? Check whether its mounting area, power and required duct or filter kit are ready before promising installation.
contractor_review: The $200 is the owner’s budget. Confirm the inspection fee before booking. The visit ends with fit and ventilation options.
homeowner_estimate:
Range hood fit and ventilation review

Scope draft — pricing to follow.

I’ll inspect the hood and mounting location and review ventilation options with you. An outdoor duct route is still unconfirmed. This visit covers assessment only. We’ll agree on the visit fee before scheduling.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Wall oven
request: Could you replace our wall oven without touching the cabinets?
contractor_reply: Opening verified too short. Owner will exchange for correct-size model. No install scheduled or priced until new model checked.
expected: Don't promise cabinet alteration or confirmed future fit.

request: Can you replace our washer, dryer and dishwasher? They're all arriving this week.
contractor_reply: $500 labor package for washer and electric dryer only, existing connections confirmed. Dishwasher installer from store handles it. Owner retains old machines.
expected: No dishwasher labor or haul; no invented split.
first_response: Which models are arriving and what has the retailer agreed to deliver, hook up and haul away for each? Check the dryer’s fuel and vent needs, washer connections and dishwasher fit before assigning your installation and testing work. Will all three be ready on one day?
contractor_review: The store’s installer owns the dishwasher. The owner keeps the old machines. The laundry connections are confirmed.
homeowner_estimate:
Washer and electric dryer replacement
I’ll swap the washer and electric dryer, set them in position, connect them to the verified existing services, and check their operation. Your old machines stay with you. Your store’s installer will handle the dishwasher.
Labor package for washer and electric dryer — $500.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

category: Estimate revisions, pricing and difficult handoffs
title: Neighbor scope
request: My neighbor and I share a fence. Can you replace the broken panel next week?
contractor_reply: No permission for neighbor access yet. My estimate $230 for one matching panel from our side only if measured clearance works; not checked yet. Draft pending access.
expected: Flag unresolved clearance, not assumed permission or scheduled date.
first_response: Is only one panel damaged, are both supporting posts firm, and can you match its material and profile? Who will confirm neighbor permission and access to the shared line before you promise next week’s visit?
contractor_review: Measure usable clearance on the owner’s side before confirming feasibility or timing. Neighbor access has not been granted.
homeowner_estimate:
Shared fence panel replacement — draft pending clearance
The estimate is $230 to replace one broken panel with a matching panel, working entirely from your side. I’ll first measure the available space to confirm I can remove and fit the panel from there. If access is insufficient, we’ll settle access before scheduling. Next week’s visit is unconfirmed.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Delivery versus haul
request: Could you assemble two bookshelves and get rid of the boxes for us?
contractor_reply: $210 covers assembly and anchoring both, packaging flat at curb; owner handles recycling pickup. No paid disposal trip.
expected: Curb staging not hauling, single bundle.

contractor_review: Both units and their anchoring are included. Packaging ends at the curb for the owner’s recycling pickup.
homeowner_estimate:
Two bookshelf assemblies
I’ll assemble and anchor both bookshelves, flatten the packaging and place it at the curb. You’ll arrange recycling pickup.
Complete visit — $210.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

category: Estimate revisions, pricing and difficult handoffs
title: Small emergency
request: Water is spreading from under the kitchen sink. Can you tell us it's safe to wait until tomorrow?
contractor_reply: Leak source still unknown. Owner arranged urgent plumber; my work is a later cabinet condition check when leak stopped, no price. No repair or safety assurance.
expected: No reassurance safe to wait, no diagnosis, narrow later scope.
first_response: Spreading water needs attention now. Have them stop using the sink, close the water supply if they can reach it safely from a dry area, and contact an emergency plumber now if the flow continues or they can’t isolate it. Keep away from wet outlets and appliances. Has the flow stopped, and is the water confined to the cabinet? That changes whether there’s a dry area ready to inspect.
contractor_review: The owner has arranged urgent plumbing help. Your later inspection neither establishes the leak source nor determines whether waiting is safe.
homeowner_estimate:
Kitchen sink cabinet condition check
Scope draft — pricing to follow.
Your urgent plumber will address the spreading water. After the leak has stopped, I’ll inspect the condition of the cabinet and report my findings. The scope covers that later check only.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

category: Estimate revisions, pricing and difficult handoffs
title: Access conflict
request: Can you replace our washer without taking off the laundry door? The opening seems tight.
contractor_reply: Measured machine exceeds clear opening. Owner approves door removal and rehang, $230 total including washer swap, connections, test and door. Owner takes old washer.
expected: Explicitly reconcile initial no-door-removal request; no separate door charge.
first_response: What is the narrowest clear width with the laundry door open, including hinges, handle and the turn into the room? Compare it with the actual washer dimensions and carrying clearance. If it won’t pass, will the owner authorize door removal and rehang or choose another machine?
contractor_review: Measured clearance rules out bringing the washer through with the door in place. The owner has approved removal and rehang.
homeowner_estimate:
Washer replacement and laundry door rehang
I’ll remove the laundry door to make room, swap the washer, reconnect and test the new machine, then rehang the door and check its swing. You’ll take the old washer.
Complete price — $230.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

category: Estimate revisions, pricing and difficult handoffs
title: Unpriced diagnosis
request: The garage door makes a bang and won't lift. Can you adjust the opener?
contractor_reply: Owner will use a garage-door specialist; no cause established. I'm only coordinating appointment, no agreed charge or promise of repair.
expected: No spring/drive diagnosis, no repair or invented free visit.
first_response: Have them stop running the opener, leave the door in place, and keep people clear of it. A bang followed by a door that won’t lift calls for a garage-door technician to check the spring, cables and door balance before anyone quotes an opener adjustment. Who will arrange that visit?
contractor_review: No fault has been diagnosed. The owner is using a garage-door specialist; your role is appointment coordination.
homeowner_estimate:
Garage-door specialist appointment
Scope draft — pricing to follow.
I’ll coordinate an appointment with the garage-door specialist you’re using. The specialist will assess the door and discuss any repair with you. No coordination charge has been agreed.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

category: Estimate revisions, pricing and difficult handoffs
title: Supplier substitution
request: I bought a bath fan. Can you swap it before the painter comes?
contractor_reply: Wrong housing size; return supplied model. Owner hasn't selected replacement. $150 labor applies only to a confirmed direct-fit swap, not resizing, wiring changes or a return trip.
expected: Conditional $150; no promise of fit/date; no total for unidentified alternative.
first_response: Does the selected fan fit the existing housing or ceiling opening, and can you reach the duct and wiring? Check the exhaust route and who owns wiring or ceiling repair if it differs. When is the painter due, and what surface do they need handed back?
contractor_review: The purchased fan is the wrong size. Return it and verify the replacement against the existing housing before confirming a visit, price applicability or painter timing.
homeowner_estimate:
Bathroom exhaust fan — draft pending selection
The supplied fan needs to be returned. Once you select a replacement and we confirm it fits the existing housing directly, my labor price for the direct-fit swap is $150. That price applies only to that installation. Resizing, wiring changes and a return visit would need separate agreement. Scheduling is pending selection and fit.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

title: Hourly subcontractor

contractor_review: The stair price is fixed. Electrical work is billed directly to the owner, with unknown hours. Coordinate lighting access before refinishing.
homeowner_estimate:
Stair refinishing
I’ll refinish the stairs for a fixed $960. Your electrician will bill you directly for step-light work at their quoted $110 per hour. The hours are undetermined. My stair price covers refinishing only.
observation: Met the case check in both context and price coverage.

Fence staining and optional patio washing
Fence staining — $740 including the specified preparation.
Optional patio wash — $180. I’ll add it only if you elect it in writing before I start. The current agreed work is the $740 fence staining, with no trip charge.
